notes.title: Update intension
notes.content:
the progress of CubeCube has been updated to the boss of Ying Long, but there are still many levels that are in an unfinished version, and I will go back and refine the level details after the overall level structure is completed, and start to make some of the randomized levels.

During this period, I will also try to increase the special effects and types of the weapon. Finish the skeletal animation of all Recall characters. Add Recall skills to the rogue system.
